title: Backcountry Beer Tasting Heli-Tour & Landing (Depart SKY Hangar)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 19 years or older to consume alcohol in British Columbia.
We have non-alcoholic beverage options upon request.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a journey into the pristine Coast Mountains of British Columbia, where breathtaking views and craft beer await. Your adventure begins with a 30 minute scenic flight over lush forests, rugged peaks, and sparkling alpine lakes. Witness the natural beauty of the region unfold beneath you. 

Touch down in a remote location nestled within the mountains. Here, amidst the tranquility of nature, you'll enjoy 30 minutes of exclusive access to unwind. 

But the adventure doesn't end there—indulge in a unique craft beer tasting experience courtesy of Twin Sails Brewery. Savour a selection of their finest brews, specially curated to complement the scenery and enhance your journey.

SINGLE PASSENGERS: We require a minimum of TWO purchased seats of any flight in order to depart. Our team will do their best to pair you up with other passengers but if you are the only passenger booked on a departure, SKY reserves the right to cancel your booking.
